exact: perturbation by symbiont of host actin cytoskeleton via inhibition of actin polymerization

definition: The process in which an organism effects a change that disrupts the host actin cytoskeleton by inhibiting host actin from polymerizing. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host actin cytoskeleton via inhibition of actin polymerization
